rules.statement: A decree for partition does not extinguish the rights of fidei commissarii but merely sets apart a specific lot to which the rights of the fidei commissarii attach in place of the share which was originally burdened with the fidei commissum, unless the purchaser is a bona fide purchaser for value without notice.
rules.supporting_quote: All it decides is that a purchaser from such a fiduciarius with knowledge of a fidei commissum cannot hold the land purchased as against a fidei commissarius. It affirms the principle that a man cannot hold what in conscience he knows he has no right to.

meta.parties: Soysa Et Al. v. Miskin Et Al
